evidence.quote: for pending orders, I can only modify the items to different options of the same product type... but I cannot completely remove individual items

observed_facts: The user wanted to remove a fleece jacket from a pending order or cancel it.
The agent told the user that individual items cannot be removed from pending orders.
The agent failed to complete the user's multiple requests including modifying a skateboard and finding grill prices.
